title: discard_duplicate
description: The active player discards, during the play cards from provinces step, a duplicate of a unique character they have in play (a copy with the same title, from their hand or face up in one of their provinces) to place 1 fate on the character in play. The province is then refilled; ending the action (`end_resolution`), which ends the opportunity to act, is a separate action of the player.

card_id.description: Duplicate discarded: a character in the hand of the player or face up in one of their provinces.

copy_id.description: Unique character in play of the player, with the same title, on which 1 fate is placed.
